\label{lemma-restriction-compare-with-pullback}
Suppose we have a diagram (\ref{equation-base-change}) where $f$ and $g$
are tor independent. Let $K \in D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Y)$. The diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
L(g')^*(Lf^*K \otimes^\mathbf{L}_{\mathcal{O}_X} a(\mathcal{O}_Y))
\ar[r] \ar[d] & L(g')^*a(K) \ar[d] \\
L(f')^*Lg^*K \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_{X'}}^\mathbf{L} a'(\mathcal{O}_{Y'})
\ar[r] & a'(Lg^*K)
}
$$
commutes where the horizontal arrows are the maps
(\ref{equation-compare-with-pullback}) for $K$ and $Lg^*K$
and the vertical maps are constructed using
Cohomology, Remark \ref{cohomology-remark-base-change} and
(\ref{equation-base-change-map}).

final_content.statement:
For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_T)$ for the unbounded derived category of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology on $T$, and let $a_f:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$. Its unit and counit are $\eta_f:\mathrm{id}\to a_fRf_*$ and $\operatorname{Tr}_f:Rf_*a_f\to\mathrm{id}$. Consider a cartesian square of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes $X'=X\times_Y Y'\xrightarrow{g'}X$ above $g:Y'\to Y$ and with vertical maps $f':X'\to Y'$ and $f:X\to Y$. Assume the pair $(f,g)$ is Tor-independent, so that the standard derived base-change map $\beta:Lg^*Rf_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*L(g')^*$ is an isomorphism. Let $a_f,a_{f'}$ be the respective right adjoints. The *duality base-change transformation* is $\alpha:L(g')^*a_f\to a_{f'}Lg^*$, constructed by adjunction from $\beta$ using its mate $Rg'_*a_{f'}\xrightarrow{\sim}a_fRg_*$. For a qcqs morphism $f:X\to Y$ with right adjoint $a_f$, let $\mu_{f,K}:Lf^*K\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to a_f(K)$ be the canonical comparison obtained by adjunction from the projection formula $Rf_*(Lf^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y))\simeq K\otimes^{\mathbf L}Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)$ followed by the counit $Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathcal O_Y$. Then for every $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ the square
\[
\begin{matrix}
L(g')^*(Lf^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y))&\xrightarrow{L(g')^*(\mu_{f,K})}&L(g')^*a_f(K)\\
\downarrow&&\downarrow\alpha_K\\
L(f')^*Lg^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}a_{f'}(\mathcal O_{Y'})&\xrightarrow{\mu_{f',Lg^*K}}&a_{f'}(Lg^*K)
\end{matrix}
\]
commutes, where the left vertical map uses derived-pullback associativity and $\alpha_{\mathcal O_Y}:L(g')^*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to a_{f'}(\mathcal O_{Y'})$. All tensors in each row are over the relevant source scheme.
hypotheses: Cartesian Tor-independent qcqs square, canonical α and projection comparisons μ.
conclusions: Base change of the projection comparison is compatible with α (commutative square).

semantic_review_note: Pinned duality.tex L1901 asserts commutativity of a square under a TOR-INDEPENDENT qcqs cartesian base-change diagram for ALL K∈D_QCoh(Y). The source horizontal maps are canonical μ_{f,K} and μ_{f',Lg*K} from the projection comparison; vertical maps are derived pullback/base-change mates. The final statement reconstructs their domains, codomains and orientation without incorrectly asserting any μ itself is an isomorphism.

\label{lemma-compare-on-open}
Let $f : X \to Y$ be a proper morphism of Noetherian schemes. Let $V \subset Y$
be an open such that $f^{-1}(V) \to V$ is an isomorphism. Then for
$K \in D_\QCoh^+(\mathcal{O}_Y)$ the map (\ref{equation-compare-with-pullback})
restricts to an isomorphism over $f^{-1}(V)$.

final_content.statement: For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_T)$ for the unbounded derived category of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology on $T$, and let $a_f:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$. Its unit and counit are $\eta_f:\mathrm{id}\to a_fRf_*$ and $\operatorname{Tr}_f:Rf_*a_f\to\mathrm{id}$. For a qcqs morphism $f:X\to Y$ with right adjoint $a_f$, let $\mu_{f,K}:Lf^*K\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to a_f(K)$ be the canonical comparison obtained by adjunction from the projection formula $Rf_*(Lf^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y))\simeq K\otimes^{\mathbf L}Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)$ followed by the counit $Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathcal O_Y$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper between Noetherian schemes. Suppose $V\subseteq Y$ is open and the restricted morphism $f^{-1}(V)\to V$ is an isomorphism. Then for each bounded-below $K\in D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$, the canonical comparison $\mu_{f,K}:Lf^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to a_f(K)$ becomes an isomorphism after restriction to $f^{-1}(V)$. No global isomorphism outside this open is asserted.
hypotheses: f proper Noetherian, f an isomorphism above open V, K bounded below.
conclusions: The projection-comparison map is an isomorphism on f^{-1}(V).

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-transitivity-compare-with-pullback}
Let $f : X \to Y$ and $g : Y \to Z$ be composable morphisms of quasi-compact
and quasi-separated schemes and set $h = g \circ f$. Let $a, b, c$ be the
adjoints of Lemma \ref{lemma-twisted-inverse-image} for $f, g, h$.
For any $K \in D_\QCoh(\mathcal{O}_Z)$ the diagram
$$
\xymatrix{
Lf^*(Lg^*K \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_Y}^\mathbf{L}
b(\mathcal{O}_Z)) \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^\mathbf{L} a(\mathcal{O}_Y)
\ar@{=}[d] \ar[r] &
a(Lg^*K \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_Y}^\mathbf{L} b(\mathcal{O}_Z)) \ar[r] &
a(b(K)) \ar@{=}[d] \\
Lh^*K \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^\mathbf{L} Lf^*b(\mathcal{O}_Z)
\otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^\mathbf{L} a(\mathcal{O}_Y) \ar[r] &
Lh^*K \otimes_{\mathcal{O}_X}^\mathbf{L} c(\mathcal{O}_Z) \ar[r] &
c(K)
}
$$
is commutative where the arrows are (\ref{equation-compare-with-pullback})
and we have used $Lh^* = Lf^* \circ Lg^*$ and $c = a \circ b$.

For a morphism $f:X\to Y$ of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes, write $D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_T)$ for the unbounded derived category of complexes with quasi-coherent cohomology on $T$, and let $a_f:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$ be the right adjoint to $Rf_*$. Its unit and counit are $\eta_f:\mathrm{id}\to a_fRf_*$ and $\operatorname{Tr}_f:Rf_*a_f\to\mathrm{id}$. For a qcqs morphism $f:X\to Y$ with right adjoint $a_f$, let $\mu_{f,K}:Lf^*K\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to a_f(K)$ be the canonical comparison obtained by adjunction from the projection formula $Rf_*(Lf^*K\otimes^{\mathbf L}a_f(\mathcal O_Y))\simeq K\otimes^{\mathbf L}Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)$ followed by the counit $Rf_*a_f(\mathcal O_Y)\to\mathcal O_Y$. Let $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$ be composable qcqs scheme maps, $h=g\circ f$, and write $a=a_f$, $b=a_g$, $c=a_h\simeq a\circ b$. For any $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)$ there are two natural maps from
\[
Lf^*(Lg^*K\otimes_Y^{\mathbf L}b(\mathcal O_Z))\otimes_X^{\mathbf L}a(\mathcal O_Y)
\]
to $c(K)$: (i) apply $\mu_{f,Lg^*K\otimes b(\mathcal O_Z)}$ and then $a(\mu_{g,K})$, or (ii) first apply the base-change associativity and the comparison at the structure sheaf to identify the source with $Lh^*K\otimes_X^{\mathbf L}c(\mathcal O_Z)$, then apply $\mu_{h,K}$. These two maps agree, with the canonical identifications of pullbacks and right adjoints.
hypotheses: Two composable qcqs maps f,g and the canonical comparison μ for f,g,h.
conclusions: Transitivity/coherence of comparison μ with composition of schemes.
